text:
talia_cs: Quick kickoff for OrionCorp reserved bring-up Friday. Need final quota, autoscale knobs, load windows, and a 20-min SRE enablement. Also tag any renewal risk items. Can ops confirm GPU count and burst allowance? Need numbers by EOD.

omar_ops: We can commit 12 GPUs (3 hosts x A100-80). Baseline target 75 rps/GPU. Short burst OK +20% for first 60m if KV cache prewarm happens.

vikram_eng: Ask Orion for traffic hist: median seq len, p95 SLA. Propose autoscale: `tokens_sec > 4000 for 90s => scale +1` and down `tokens_sec < 1500 for 4m => scale -1`. Cooldown 180s.

sophie_se: I'll run the 20-min enablement at 11:00 PT: agenda runbook, failover demo, how to raise a latency incident. Will share feedback survey link.

pager-bot: Alert rules to add: `error_rate > 0.75% for 5m`, `p95_latency > 280ms for 10m`, `queue_depth > 800`. Pager rotation attached.

talia_cs: Renewal note: AMs flagged sensitivity on throughput/latency. If p95 breaches 280ms during smoke or first day, we escalate and offer a mitigation plan.

omar_ops: Load plan: quick smoke 10m ~12k reqs after canary, then full shadow 35m ~55k reqs. Tool command: `./load --profile orion_shadow --duration 35m --requests 55000`. Prewarm KV 12m.

vikram_eng: Pin model: `orion-lambda-13b@v3` quant `q4_0`. Fallback: older checkpoint with lower concurrency. I'll push runtime config.

sophie_se: Post-run capture: short Google form + triage board. I'll post link and a tiny JIRA template in onboarding doc.

talia_cs: Summary: pool=12 GPUs, burst +20% for 60m, smoke then full shadow, autoscale tokens rules as above, alerts set. Ops/Eng confirm prewarm schedule and I'll notify AMs. Thanks!
